audit.notes: AUTO Person/Organization injection skipped: Organization already present; no confirmed Person author credentials on site — never fabricate.

findings.title: Sitewide Organization JSON-LD present with core trust props

evidence.observed: base.html emits Organization @id #organization with name "銘印鑽石 IMPRINT DIAMOND", legalName "心之銘印鑽石有限公司", url, logo, contactPoint (telephone +886-2-2977-0268, customer service, TW), sameAs Facebook + LINE.

findings.expected: Organization with name, url, logo, contactPoint, sameAs[] on site templates.
findings.recommendation: Keep Organization block; when legal confirms more profiles (YouTube already linked on About), extend sameAs via M6 with confirmed URLs only.

verification.assertion: Organization JSON-LD includes name, url, logo, contactPoint, sameAs

expected_impact.rationale: Tier-1 Organization schema is a documented trust/entity signal for Search and AI extractors; presence is foundational, not a ranking guarantee.

findings.title: About page discoverable from nav and footer

evidence.observed: Route /about → pages/about.html in config/routes.py. Nav links 「關於我們」/「品牌故事」; footer 「瞭解更多」→「品牌故事」; homepage CTAs to /about.
evidence.snippet: 關於我們 … 品牌故事

findings.expected: Discoverable About page linked from global chrome.
findings.recommendation: Keep About linked sitewide; optionally add team/credentials when real people are ready to be named.

verification.assertion: Global nav/footer contain href=/about and route exists

expected_impact.rationale: Discoverable About is a core E-E-A-T trust surface for brand/entity understanding.

findings.title: Contact page discoverable with NAP + contactPoint

evidence.observed: Route /contact exists. Nav CTA 「聯絡我們」, footer address/phone/LINE + link to /contact. Page shows NAP, map, form; JewelryStore JSON-LD + sitewide Organization contactPoint.

findings.expected: Discoverable Contact with reachable channels and schema contactPoint.
findings.recommendation: Keep Contact primary; ensure footer legal note stays consistent with published policies.

verification.assertion: Contact route + visible NAP + Organization.contactPoint present

expected_impact.rationale: Contact discoverability and contactPoint support Trust and local entity confidence.

findings.title: Returns/cancellation policy published and footer-linked

evidence.observed: Route /return-policy in routes.py; page covers DNA custom no-return rules, deposit, carat variance, shipping damage; footer links 「退款與退貨政策」; sitemap includes URL.
evidence.snippet: 一經製作或啟動生產流程後，恕無法取消、退貨或退款

findings.recommendation: Keep policy indexable and linked; align shop calculator terms with this page.

verification.assertion: Footer links /return-policy and template has substantive policy copy

expected_impact.rationale: Visible returns policy is a vertical-appropriate Trust signal for custom jewelry commerce.

findings.title: DNA knowledge page shows process/methodology experience markers

evidence.observed: Page details CVD context, 6-step process (sample→growth 70–90 days→cut→cert→jewelry→memorial box), sample quantities, GIA/IGI outbound links, lab-visit CTA to /contact; About adds Taiwan lab + appointment narrative.
evidence.snippet: 元素注入生長設備…約需 70–90 天 … 0.20 克拉以上可代送 GIA 或 IGI

findings.expected: Experience markers: methodology, first-hand process detail, verifiable references where claims are made.
findings.recommendation: Keep process depth; add last-reviewed date and source footnotes for absolute claims (see transparency findings).

verification.assertion: what-is-dna-diamond contains multi-step process and certification references

expected_impact.rationale: First-hand process detail supports Experience/Expertise framing for AI citation and quality raters; not a direct ranking lever.

findings.title: Editorial/knowledge pages lack visible author byline

evidence.observed: Sampled /, /about, /what-is-dna-diamond: no visible byline, rel=author, or author bio link. Brand voice only (銘印鑽石). Journal template also has no author markup in templates.
evidence.snippet:
什麼是 DNA 鑽石

— no byline sibling

findings.expected: Editorial/knowledge pages show named author (or clear org-as-author) with link to bio when a real person stands behind claims.
findings.recommendation: If a real expert/advisor will own DNA explainers, add byline + bio page with credentials. Until then, keep org-as-publisher and do not invent Person names.

verification.assertion: No byline/rel=author/Person author UI on knowledge templates

expected_impact.rationale: Named authorship strengthens E-E-A-T on explanatory pages; brand-only authorship is weaker for expertise claims.

findings.title: No Person JSON-LD author entity anywhere in templates

evidence.observed: Grep across content/site/templates: Organization, JewelryStore, WebSite, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList present; zero @type Person blocks. No confirmed author name/jobTitle/sameAs on site to auto-inject.
evidence.snippet: JSON-LD types present: Organization, JewelryStore, WebSite, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList — Person: none

findings.expected: When a human author is shown, Person schema with name, jobTitle, knowsAbout, sameAs[] matching visible credentials.
findings.recommendation: Supply confirmed author profile (name, jobTitle, bio URL, LinkedIn/Wikidata). Only then emit Person JSON-LD (fixable auto). Do not invent credentials.

verification.assertion: No Person nodes in template JSON-LD

expected_impact.rationale: Person schema helps machines attach expertise; fabricating one is a trust risk worse than omission.

findings.title: Privacy policy exists but is draft, noindex, incomplete

evidence.observed: Route /privacy exists with partial collection disclosure, but meta robots noindex,nofollow; callout says draft pending legal; multiple TODO items (retention, processors, rights, cookies/GA). Footer states privacy still being prepared and does not link /privacy. Not in sitemap.xml sample.
evidence.snippet: <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> … 「本頁面為草稿，尚待法務審閱」… TODO：個人資料保存期限

findings.expected: Indexable, complete privacy policy linked from footer for a commerce site collecting PII (contact form, accounts, Google login).
findings.recommendation: Legal finalize TODOs, remove draft callout, drop noindex when ready, add footer link. Tool must not invent legal copy.

verification.assertion: privacy.html is noindex draft with TODO list; footer lacks /privacy link

expected_impact.rationale: Incomplete/hidden privacy policy weakens Trust for sites collecting personal data; high-severity trust gap, not a guaranteed ranking delta.

findings.title: Terms of service exist but are draft, noindex, incomplete

evidence.observed: Route /terms present with service/pricing/timeline excerpts from FAQ, but robots noindex,nofollow; draft callout; TODOs for deposit/cancel, liability, IP, jurisdiction, amendment. Footer says terms still WIP; no footer href=/terms. Register flow links /terms but page remains draft.
evidence.snippet: <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> … TODO：訂金／付款方式與比例、取消訂單之處理方式

findings.expected: Published, indexable (or consciously gated) terms linked from footer/checkout, complete for custom-order commerce.
findings.recommendation: Legal complete TODOs; align with return-policy + shop calculator terms; then link from footer and reconsider noindex.

expected_impact.rationale: Missing finished terms reduces commercial Trust and transparency for custom-order purchases.

findings.title: Footer legal note omits links to existing privacy/terms routes

evidence.observed: Footer: 「退款與退貨政策」linked; text says privacy/terms still being prepared — no href to /privacy or /terms despite routes+templates existing (used by register).
evidence.snippet: 退款與退貨政策已整理公告；隱私權與服務條款仍整理中，完成後將公告於本網站。

findings.expected: When privacy/terms are ready to publish, footer should link them; until then copy should match true availability without implying absence of any draft.
findings.recommendation: After legal sign-off: add footer links. Optional proposed diff only after pages leave draft/noindex — do not promote unfinished legal pages as final.

findings.title: No visible last-reviewed / dateModified on knowledge pages

evidence.observed: what-is-dna-diamond and about lack visible「最後更新日期」/reviewed-by lines; no Article schema datePublished/dateModified on these pages.
evidence.snippet: Hero + process sections only — no dateModified / 最後審閱 UI

findings.expected: Knowledge pages show last-reviewed date (and schema dateModified when Article markup is used), matching real updates.
findings.recommendation: Add a visible reviewed date from real editorial calendar; never backdate. Pair with M13 if Article schema is added later.

verification.assertion: No last-reviewed / dateModified markers on DNA knowledge template

expected_impact.rationale: Freshness/review transparency supports Trust and AI citation confidence; impact is correlational.

findings.title: Strong absolute claims lack citations or methodology footnotes

evidence.observed: Repeated claims: 「全台唯一擁有在地 DNA 鑽石培育實驗室」; 「超過 60 台鑽石培育艙」; 「十年以上的高科技與工藝經驗」 — no footnote, third-party citation, or evidence link beyond GIA/IGI for certificates.
evidence.snippet: 實驗室擁有超過 60 台鑽石培育艙，結合台灣團隊十年以上的高科技與工藝經驗。

findings.expected: Absolute/superlative claims either cited or qualified; experience claims tied to verifiable evidence.
findings.recommendation: Add sourcing or soft-qualify claims; keep GIA/IGI links. Do not invent certifications or awards.

verification.assertion: Absolute claims present without citation blocks
verification.reproduce: rg -n "全台唯一|60 台|十年以上" content/site/templates/pages/what-is-dna-diamond.html content/site/templates/pages/about.html content/site/templates/pages/index.html

expected_impact.rationale: Unsourced absolute claims weaken Trust and AI citation safety; citing them is advisory editorial work.
